{{Otheruses|Minister of Defense}}
'''Minister of Defense''' was a position held by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] within the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government. He served the [[Inner Council (New Republic)|Inner Council]] and [[New Republic High Command/Legends|New Republic High Command]].
